@PlutonixBT I just find it funny that we continue mistaking a lack of vol for strength (but only discussed when other risk assets are going down)

I find it even funnier than the four year cycle topped to the *day* we had discussed in September, and for some reason they're disrespecting the theory again by front running it by 3+ months thinking we have gone down "enough" and general difficulty finding bearish catalysts (that in of itself is a bearish catalyst lmao)
